data.summary: The reviews are overwhelmingly positive and lack any critical feedback, which is unusual. However, they contain enough specific service details and span a reasonable timeframe to suggest a core of authentic, satisfied customers. The complete absence of negative reviews or complaints, while a potential red flag, is consistent with a small, owner-operated business (Andrew) that carefully manages its client volume and reputation. The lack of presence on other review platforms is notable for a 3-year-old company.
fake_signals: Reviews are uniformly positive with no constructive feedback
Several reviews mention the same owner (Andrew) in a very similar, generic praising tone
Lack of reviews on other major platforms (Yelp, Angi, Houzz) for a 3-year-old company
authentic_signals: Reviews contain specific project types (roof replacement, gutter installation, dryer vent inspection)
Some reviews mention specific helpful actions (help with insurance claim, free inspection, before/after photos)
Varied reviewer names and posting dates over a 1-2 year period
BBB shows an A+ rating with no complaints, suggesting good business practices
data.discrepancy_explanation: Only Google and BBB have ratings. A 5.0 Google rating with an A+ BBB is consistent for a small, newer company with no complaints.

reviews.text: Highly recommend! Matador Roofing did an excellent job on my new roof! Andrew gave me all the info I needed and answered all my questions. He visited to inspect my roof, explained the situation and provided guidance, was very informative and helpful throughout the whole process, he was extremely knowledgeable and professional. The crew that installed the roof and gutters was very courteous and keep my property clean. Excellent attention-to-detail, honest, and a professional crew.
reviews.author: Paola Aldana

reviews.text: Andrew and his guys were nothing but fantastic! Not only did they thoroughly inspect my roof but they also ensured that I had an equal understanding of each step of the process when carrying out my installation. Highly recommend Matador Roofing & Construction to everyone!
reviews.author: Sara Naser

reviews.text: My step mom needed her roof fixed fast. Andrew came out and inspected the property and got everything fixed shortly after. He was very responsive and on time. I am very happy with the service he provided us! I would highly recommend him to any of my friends or family members.
reviews.author: Miranda Price

reviews.text: If you’re look for a great roofing company who will help you in the process of filing an insurance claim, Matador Roofing and Construction is the company to hire. Not only did they help me file the claim but they inspected my roof for free. They took pictures and showed me all the damaged my roof have taken throughout the years. Very respectful and polite guys. Always on time and always kept me updated with what was going on.
reviews.author: Bryant Prado

reviews.text:
Great experience!!
Andrew is very knowledgeable and professional ! Led me through the entire process of getting a roof repair since my home needed some Love..
Andrew and his crew exceeded my expectations and some. Thank you so much!! Definitely recommend to anyone that may need ANY kind of home repair!!
reviews.author: Alejandro Sanchez

reviews.text: We needed our dryer vent inspected for possible damage. Matador was on time, professional, and their guys explained what exactly the issue was and how they were going to fix it, along with before and after pictures of their work for proof. And the cost was cheap too! They can definitely do more than just roofing, can’t recommend them enough!
reviews.author: Edward Sergeant

reviews.text: i highly recommend Andrew and Matador Roofing! When I reached out about new gutters, I had a quote and installstatian in record timing, and the finished product looks fantastic! Andrew is responsive, transparent, and trustworthy.
reviews.author: Meagan Meredith

reviews.text: Andrew has helped me with several homes and his service is superb every time. He is responsive and takes care of his clients. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Levy P.

reviews.text: Andrew is professional and really cares about his customers. The quality of work is incredible. I definitely recommend him!
reviews.author: Ashley Jurak

reviews.text: Andrew is a very nice gentleman, with a flexible schedule who communicates very well. I did not have any problems dealing with this company and would recommend to anyone!
reviews.author: Ben Gordon

reviews.text: A great experience - excellent communication and customer service. I understood where we were in the process at all times and the Matador crew did a great job.
reviews.author: dana wilson

reviews.text: Highly recommend Andrew and Matador Roofing! Extremely professional and amazing, stress-free work!
reviews.author: Ale Montes Isaac

reviews.text: I’m so pleased with their work! Very efficient and very helpful. Would highly recommend!
reviews.author: Marissa Hallstrom
